slices.label: Adjacency-array explicit construction with bounded neighborhood independence
slices.task: Output an explicit maximal independent set
assumptions: Degree and i-th-neighbor queries in O(1) time, adjacency-array representation
β(G) is maximum size of an independent set inside the neighborhood of any vertex

results.sourceLocation: Result 1; input access specified after Result 1
results.notes: Sublinear in m only when β(G) is sufficiently small; not an adjacency-matrix guarantee.

results.bound: Ω(n β(G)) time for β from constant to Θ(n)
results.guarantee: Explicit maximal independent set in the stated adjacency-array model
results.notes: Hard instances parameterized by β(G); use with the matching upper only under the same input-access model. The proof extends an earlier general-graph lower bound.

papers.title: When Algorithms for Maximal Independent Set and Maximal Matching Run in Sublinear Time
